edges.sentence: On 2026-10-03, Deutsche Welle reported “The co-pilot accused of stabbing his captain during Flydubai Flight 1073 was wielding a crash ax and attempted to carry out a "terrorist attack," UAE investigators said Saturday, according to Emirati state news agency WAM.”; on the same day, France 24 reported “The co-pilot of Flydubai flight FZ1073 attempted to carry out a "terrorist" attack during the flight, the United Arab Emirates prosecutor general said on Saturday, according to the state news agency WAM.”.

On 2026-10-03, The Guardian reported “UAE senior diplomatic adviser Anwar Gargash on Friday called the attack a “dangerous terrorist act”.”; on the same day, Deutsche Welle reported “The co-pilot accused of stabbing his captain during Flydubai Flight 1073 was wielding a crash ax and attempted to carry out a "terrorist attack," UAE investigators said Saturday, according to Emirati state news agency WAM.”.

On 2026-10-03, The Guardian reported “UAE senior diplomatic adviser Anwar Gargash on Friday called the attack a “dangerous terrorist act”.”; on the same day, France 24 reported “The co-pilot of Flydubai flight FZ1073 attempted to carry out a "terrorist" attack during the flight, the United Arab Emirates prosecutor general said on Saturday, according to the state news agency WAM.”.

On 2026-10-03, BBC reported “The UAE attorney general told state media that investigations were ongoing to determine the full circumstances and motives of the incident.”; on the same day, France 24 reported “Investigations are ongoing to determine the circumstances of the incident, the motives and any related connections, as well as to examine physical and digital evidence, he added.”.
